en.headline: Man dies after fall at Sheung Shui construction site
en.dek: Police said a man in his forties was found unconscious at a Po Kin Road site on Monday afternoon and was later certified dead.
body: A man in his forties died after a fall at a construction site on Po Kin Road in Sheung Shui on Monday afternoon, police and rescuers said.

Police received a report at about 4.20pm that the man was suspected to have fallen from height and was unconscious, HK01 reported. He was understood to have fallen from a temporary site office. The site is the expansion works for North District Hospital, according to Sing Tao.
Rescuers found him unconscious and took him to North District Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Police said an investigation was under way.
No name has been released. Authorities have not stated the height of the fall or given a cause.

zh.headline: 上水地盤男子墮下送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方稱下午約4時20分接報保健路地盤有約40歲男子昏迷，其後證實不治。
body: 上水保健路一個地盤星期一午後有一名約40歲男子墮下，送院後不治。
《香港01》報道，警方下午約4時20分接報，指該名男子懷疑從高處墮下，當場昏迷。據了解，他懷疑從地盤內一個臨時辦公室墮下。星島日報報道，現場為北區醫院擴建地盤。
救援人員到場時他已不省人事，由救護車送往北區醫院，其後證實不治。警方表示正在調查。
當局暫未公布死者姓名，亦未說明墮下高度或原因。
